name: Faurschou Foundation Copenhagen
notes: Faurschou Foundation at Klubiensvej 11 in Nordhavn (Frihavnen), in a converted harbour warehouse. Refined 6 Oct 2026 from the ground file's OpenStreetMap outlines and published addresses, not photographs (published descriptions of the building are thin). The first model had the warehouse running at 122 degrees across the site and standing 30 m south-east of its outline (on 50%); it now lies on the outline: a four-storey block about 38 m deep, its quay-side wall at 110 degrees along the basin, running north-west off the site from its south-east end, which stands just east of the museum's point. In front, the quay road and the stone quay edge with bollards, the harbour water north and north-east as the ground has it; behind, a paved yard and the low one-storey hall to the east. Modelled as a typical Frihavn warehouse: pale yellow brick, flat roof, floor bands, a regular window grid on both long faces, loading doors along the quay, the foundation's galleries at the south-east end with a white-painted, opened-up ground floor, glazed doors and an entrance canopy. Guessed: the brick colour, the windows, which end the galleries occupy and how far they run, the height (16.5 m).
